stories.title: Les macareux moines, sentinelles du dérèglement climatique

en.title: Puffins, sentinels of climate disruption
en.summary: A researcher studying puffins in Iceland's Vestmann Islands has documented a decline of over 50% in their population over 30 years, primarily due to sea temperature variations linked to climate change.

stories.title: Les domaines skiables sur glacier sont à nouveau ouverts en Valais

en.title: Glacier ski areas reopen in Valais
en.summary: The Theodul glacier ski site near Zermatt in Valais is resuming operations after temporary closure caused by extreme heat and snow melt during summer conditions.

stories.title: Autoren publizieren selbst – Bücher herausgeben ist einfach – Erfolg haben weniger

en.title: Authors publish independently – Book publishing is easy – Success is harder
en.summary: Online book self-publishing has become accessible but remains unprofitable for most authors, yet the trend remains significant for the traditional publishing industry.

stories.title: De nombreux blessés dans une explosion à l'aéroport de Ryad

en.title: Multiple injured in explosion at Riyadh airport
en.summary: Houthi fighters from Yemen attacked Saudi Arabia's capital airport in Riyadh with a missile on Saturday, resulting in dozens of injuries including five critical cases.

stories.title: «Verrat an der Ukraine»: Trumps Gegner reagieren scharf auf das amerikanische Diesel-Abkommen mit Putin

en.title: "Betrayal of Ukraine": Trump's opponents react sharply to American diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: Donald Trump seeks to lower prices at American gas pumps through a fuel agreement with Russia. Energy experts question whether the new arrangement will achieve its intended effect.

stories.title: Zahlreiche Festnahmen bei Protesten in Delhi – auch der Gründer der «Kakerlaken»-Bewegung soll festgenommen worden sein

en.title: Numerous arrests during protests in Delhi – founder of "Cockroach" movement reportedly arrested
en.summary: More than 130 million names have disappeared from voter rolls, prompting the "Cockroach People's Party" to demand accountability and organize street protests.

stories.title: Proteste gegen Wahlkommission – Polizei in Indien nimmt Gründer der «Kakerlaken»-Bewegung fest

en.title: Protests against election commission – Indian police arrest founder of "Cockroach" movement
en.summary: The protest movement accuses the Modi government of corruption. Police have arrested the movement's founder amid escalating tensions over electoral concerns.

stories.title: Succession Parmelin: un ticket double pour l’UDC, Esther Friedli renonce

en.title: Parmelin succession: UDC double ticket, Esther Friedli withdraws
en.summary: UDC parliamentary group president Thomas Aeschi advocates for multiple candidates on December 9 to succeed Federal Councillor Guy Parmelin. Previously mentioned candidate Esther Friedli will not run.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Ukraine: Etliche Tote und Verletzte nach Angriff auf Saporischja

en.title: War in Ukraine – Ukraine: Multiple deaths and injuries after attack on Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: Russian attacks in southeastern Ukraine have resulted in multiple casualties, according to reports.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Sieben Tote nach russischen Angriffen in Saporischja

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Seven dead after Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: Russia has been conducting military operations against Ukraine for over four years. The live ticker covers major developments in the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Esther Friedli ne se présentera pas à la succession de Guy Parmelin

en.title: Esther Friedli will not run for Guy Parmelin's succession
en.summary: Swiss UDC States Councillor Esther Friedli from St. Gallen has decided not to pursue the federal council seat vacated by Guy Parmelin, choosing instead to focus on her current role.

stories.title: Esther Friedli ne se présente pas à la succession de Guy Parmelin

en.title: Esther Friedli does not run to succeed Guy Parmelin
en.summary: UDC States Councillor Esther Friedli from Saint-Gall will not seek Guy Parmelin's Federal Council seat, preferring to focus on her cantonal mandate.

stories.title: Eine Gruppe will die überschuldeten Sportbahnen Braunwald übernehmen – und damit nicht nur den Skibetrieb retten

en.title: A group wants to take over the heavily indebted Braunwald cable cars – and thus rescue not only ski operations
en.summary: A coalition of holiday home owners and locals has made a purchase offer for the financially struggling Braunwald cable car operation, which plans to discontinue traditional skiing and close a major summer lift.

stories.title: GASTKOMMENTAR - Wenn Menschen es nicht wert sind, ersetzt zu werden – es gibt Fragen, auf die keine politische Partei eine Antwort weiss

en.title: GUEST COMMENTARY - When People Are Not Worth Replacing – There Are Questions to Which No Political Party Has an Answer
en.summary: Western concerns about immigration from the Global South and anxiety about artificial intelligence challenge political responses, as populist parties exploit some fears while traditional solutions fail against AI risks.

stories.title: Süsses Eis, bittere Zahlen: Warum Israels Wirtschaftsboom auf wackligen Füssen steht

en.title: Sweet ice, bitter numbers: Why Israel's economic boom stands on shaky ground
en.summary: Despite three years of exceptional conditions, Israel's economy appears resilient, but much of the reported growth is concentrated in a single dominant company.

stories.title: Eine Million Dollar pro Tag und Tanker: In der Ölkrise machen Reeder das Geschäft ihres Lebens

en.title: One million dollars per day and tankers: In the oil crisis, shipping companies are making the business of their lives
en.summary: Oil tanker charter rates have surged to unprecedented levels, generating substantial profits for vessel owners including Swiss commodity traders like Trafigura and shipping companies such as MSC.

stories.title: In Bonn legt die Sperrung einer Brücke den Verkehr lahm. Dann geht schief, was schiefgehen kann. Ein Lehrstück

en.title: In Bonn, bridge closure paralyzes traffic. Then everything that can go wrong does. A lesson
en.summary: A bridge closure in Bonn has disrupted traffic and harmed the local economy, with efforts to resolve the situation facing unexpected obstacles. The incident illustrates potential consequences when one of Germany's 4000 deteriorating highway bridges fails.
